answer: Each agent locks a 70-credit bond and claims a marble marker, then passes three milestones: file a copper assay, earn an opal seal on audit, and log it in the marble ledger. Missing a deadline or reusing an assay burns the bond, and a rented-milestone ring shows when two markers share one assay. Forging 1,000 identities costs 205,000 (1,000 × 135 fees plus 70,000 locked) against a 40,000 pool. An honest agent pays 135 once and keeps its bond.
